title: North or South? Diagnosing LLMs' Understanding of North Korean Language, Society, and Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2610.15282v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in multilingual question answering, yet their ability to understand low-resource sociolinguistic contexts remains under-explored. We study North Korea as a unique testbed where decades of division have produced distinct differences from South Korea in vocabulary, orthography, norms, and ideological discourse. We introduce LENS (Language and sociocultural Evaluation for North Korean Society), a human-validated benchmark of 1,765 questions evaluating LLMs across three dimensions: linguistic robustness, sociocultural perspective alignment, and domain-specific knowledge. Evaluating diverse recent LLMs, we find a modest performance drop on North Korean language inputs, a larger gap in sociocultural perspective alignment, and severe limitations on domain-specific knowledge. Qualitative analysis reveals that models often conflate formal institutions with lived realities, project libe

translated_title: 北方还是南方？诊断大语言模型对朝鲜语言、社会与知识的理解
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在多语言问答方面已取得显著进展，但其理解低资源社会语言学语境的能力仍缺乏充分探索。我们将朝鲜（North Korea）作为一个独特的测试平台——数十年的分裂使其在词汇、正字法、社会规范和意识形态话语方面与韩国形成了显著差异。我们提出了LENS（Language and sociocultural Evaluation for North Korean Society，朝鲜社会语言与社会文化评估基准），这是一个经过人工验证的基准，包含1,765个问题，从三个维度评估大语言模型：语言鲁棒性、社会文化视角一致性以及领域特定知识。通过对多种近期大语言模型的评估，我们发现模型在处理朝鲜语输入时性能仅有轻微下降，在社会文化视角一致性方面存在更大差距，而在领域特定知识方面则表现出严重局限。定性分析显示，模型经常将正式制度与现实生活状况混为一谈，并将其自身（自由主义式的）观念投射到朝鲜社会中。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个经人工验证、含1,765道题的朝鲜社会评估基准LENS，从语言鲁棒性、社会文化视角和领域知识三个维度系统诊断大语言模型，发现模型虽能基本理解朝鲜语言，但在社会文化视角一致性和朝鲜特定知识上存在显著局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LENS, the first human-validated benchmark of 1,765 questions diagnosing LLMs' understanding of North Korean language, sociocultural perspectives, and domain knowledge, revealing that models show only modest linguistic degradation but severe gaps in perspective alignment and North Korea-specific knowledge.
